name: agents-inc-monorepo
//: Prettier config for every workspace; packages/cli's nearer config wins there. Prettier reads .prettierignore only from its working directory, so `format` runs from the root.

scripts.//prepare: Hooks live in the root .husky/, so the root package installs them.
scripts.//format: One run from the root, not `turbo format`, so the root .prettierignore applies.
scripts.//format:check: The same glob as `format`, so what CI refuses is what `format` fixes.
scripts.//deps:check: Cross-workspace checks no per-workspace gate can see: syncpack ranges plus shared tsconfig, vitest and eslint configs, and that each workspace's vitest config collects every test file outside e2e/. A workspace opts out with a //no-shared-* key giving the reason.
scripts.deps:check: syncpack lint && bun packages/cli/scripts/run-check-shared-tsconfig.ts && bun packages/cli/scripts/run-check-shared-vitest-config.ts && bun packages/cli/scripts/run-check-shared-eslint-config.ts && bun packages/cli/scripts/run-check-vitest-collects-every-test.ts
scripts.//deps:dead: knip across every workspace. Not a gate: its output is read by hand. Tuning lives in knip.jsonc.

//lint-staged: ESLint (config resolved per file) then Prettier on staged files. Patterns are disjoint because lint-staged runs them concurrently; packages/vitest-config has no eslint config, so it gets formatting only.
